{"templates":[],"no_rule_reason":"Piece 325-18A does not set a limit that code can check against the measures we have. It is a counting rule: porches, decks, balconies projecting more than two feet, ramps and landings count as part of the building when yards and lot coverage are measured. Yards and lot coverage are limited by the chart rows, which are drafted from the chart, not here. Applying this piece needs measures for the porch, deck, balcony, ramp and landing footprints and projections, and those are not in the list. The measures building_area, front_yard, side_yard_smaller, side_yard_larger and rear_yard are already defined by the city as including these structures. A rule here would either repeat the chart limits or guess at how to measure projections, which would risk a false pass. The measurement questions are for the architects: does a balcony projecting exactly two feet count, from which point is the projection measured, and does a landing count when it is not attached to a building."}
